goal: Reduce repeated provider and DoH TLS handshake bytes within the already isolated economy ProviderTransportPool.
context: Bounded follow-up to reviewed 722ca1c (identity ticket-only TLS) and deployed b5cc331. Measured remaining provider API bytes about 1.9KB/sec after existing keepalive/cache changes; optimize reconnect handshakes too. On creation of a pooled gateway, attach one NEW eight-entry expiring TLS session cache shared only by its own destination and DoH configs, lifetime ten minutes matching existing raw transport lifetime. The existing pool is enabled only by per-account economy rollout and keys account+proxy credentials+provider/generation/epoch/sticky/IP revision. Never use the global identity cache for providers; never share across entries/revisions/credentials. Flag off/unpooled paths unchanged. Preserve TLS defaults, certificate verification, all per-request SQL guards, metadata capacity authority, DNS TTL, deadlines, and cleanup. No request/result caching beyond existing policies. Add real CONNECT/TLS test proving new socket resumption within a scope and full handshake on revision replacement, plus TLS state isolation assertions in concurrent pool tests. Full suite and six-package race, actual API review on exact tested source. No subagents. Deploy together with reviewed identity TLS after current scheduler sample ends; canary first, preserve unknown operations/recovery checkpoint; browser manager disabled after standard deployment.
commit_message: perf(network): resume TLS within isolated provider transports
